'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is produced at the [[Church workbench]] by combining the basic fertilizer [[peat]] with two [[flavor enhancer]], the latter requiring advanced [[alchemy]]. Like all fertilizers, a single unit may be applied to a single farming plot - either an [[empty garden bed]], [[garden bed with sticks]], or [[vine trellis]] - in order to provide a benefit to the subsequently planted crop.

The benefit of a "Quality" fertilizer - note the star icon - is an overall improvement to a crop's yield. In regards to {{PAGENAME}} specifically, the given crop's return on average will be improved significantly. With basic crops, the produce will be increased by 6 and the seeds will be increased by 3. With quality crops, the produce and seeds will be increased by 2, as well as guaranteeing 2 upgraded produce and seeds. If the crop itself is already gold-quality, this benefit will simply be added to the return, or 4 extra produce and seeds total. For additional information regarding the effects and use of fertilizer, see [[farming]].
